crossRefs.note: With you there shall be a man of every tribe, each one head of his fathers’ house.
First, the standard of the camp of the children of Judah went forward according to their armies. Nahshon the son of…
These were their names: Of the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur.
When I came to you, brothers, I didn’t come with excellence of speech or of wisdom, proclaiming to you the testimony of…
For I determined not to know anything among you except Jesus Christ and him crucified.
